Sandbox_EnableCommandCenter_tooltip: Allows higher ranked command players to open the CSR Admin Command Center. Basic players remain denied server-side.
Sandbox_MinimumAccessLevel_tooltip: Lowest command rank allowed to open and control the command center. 1=Admin, 2=Moderator, 3=Overseer, 4=GM, 5=Observer.
Sandbox_AllowObserverReadOnly_tooltip: Allows Observer accounts to view the command center without access to control or export actions.
Sandbox_MaxRowsPerPage_tooltip: Maximum claim rows returned to the client in one page.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleMovementTracking_to: Tracks movement from CSR claimed-vehicle rows on a throttled server interval. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_VehicleTrackingIntervalMinutes_t: How often the command center checks claimed-vehicle rows for meaningful movement.
Sandbox_VehicleMovementThresholdTiles_to: Minimum movement distance before a claimed vehicle movement log entry is written.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClaimAuthoritySnaps: Stores a server-side ModData snapshot of CSR vehicle claim rows keyed by durable vehicle identity.
Sandbox_PadlockScanTileCap_tooltip: Maximum loaded claim-area tiles ACC checks when refreshing CSR padlock tracking. Keeps lock tracking from becoming a full-map scan.
Sandbox_PadlockScanMaxZ_tooltip: Highest Z level ACC checks while looking for CSR padlocked containers in loaded claim areas.
Sandbox_DebugLogMaxEntries_tooltip: Maximum recent debug entries kept in the in-memory tail.
Sandbox_MaxMapMarkers_tooltip: Maximum claimed vehicle markers the map layer should show when marker rendering is enabled in a later phase.
